statement.excerpt: I’m just gonna come out and say it: I think a lot of these data center deals are trash, will never get built, and thus will never get paid.
statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: a lot of these data center deals
our_interpretation: The factual commitment is that a substantial number of the announced AI infrastructure deals under discussion will permanently fail to produce the contracted facilities and consequently will not receive the associated payments.
Trash is an opinion and is not assessed.
A lot does not specify a count, percentage or denominator. No numerical threshold is invented.
Never getting paid is interpreted as failure to receive the contemplated operating-contract payments, rather than a claim that no contractor, lender or developer receives any money.
There is no specified deadline. Delay, tenant withdrawal and permanent project abandonment are distinct events.
This concerns a sector-level set of deals, not a specified company's financial statement metric.
criteria.support_condition: Records identify a clearly substantial set of the referenced deals that permanently ended without the contracted facilities being delivered, together with evidence that noncompletion prevented the contemplated payments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Completion and payment records for all or essentially all of an identifiable referenced cohort leave no substantial set fitting the prediction. A single completed project is insufficient.
